input: Set up a college alumni networking profile online

gold.taskTitle: Set Up College Alumni Networking Profile Online
gold.taskDescription: Create and configure an online networking profile specifically to connect with college alumni.

questions.title: Which college or university are you alumni of?
questions.description: Identify the specific institution to tailor the profile to the right alumni network.

questions.title: Which platform do you want to use for this?
questions.description: Determine the target platform, such as LinkedIn, your school's official alumni portal, Graduway, or another network.

questions.title: What is your primary goal for this profile?
questions.description: Understand whether the user wants to find a job, mentor others, reconnect with classmates, or something else.

questions.title: What industry or professional field are you in?
questions.description: Capture the user's career area so the profile content can be focused and relevant.

questions.title: Do you already have any existing profiles to build from?
questions.description: Find out if the user has a LinkedIn, resume, or prior alumni profile that can be referenced or imported.

questions.title: How complete is your current professional background information?
questions.description: Assess whether the user has their work history, skills, and education details readily available to fill in the profile.

questions.title: Do you have a professional photo ready to upload?
questions.description: Determine if the user needs to source or prepare a suitable profile photo as part of the setup process.
